rationale: The plan fits the 3v3 unpaired single-batch design precisely (DESeq2 Wald plus edgeR QL cross-check, explicit reference level, named contrast, no batch/interaction terms invented), and directly answers the power/confidence half via method concordance, leave-one-out fragility, and a stated power figure without loosening alpha. QC precedes testing with blind VST, PCA on top 500 genes, distance heatmap, library sizes, and an explicit no-removal-but-flag policy. The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples) is minimal and justified, normalization is strictly inside the model (DESeq2 size factors, edgeR TMM) with raw counts passed downstream, and BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage is correctly separated from ranking/unshrunken reporting. Enrichment is well-justified given the expected small significant list, uses fgsea preranked on the full list with a stated ranking metric, explicit universe, named/versioned collections, size window, and honest handling of the missing Reactome collection. The final report ties every element together with versions, thresholds, counts, and caveats, fully matching the reference's expectations.
